25
Ahomegyeɛ afe
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose Sinai bepɔ so sɛ: 2Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ moduru asase a mede merema mo no so a, asase no nhome nni home afe mma AWURADE. 3#Eks 23.10-11; Deut 15.1-11 Mfeɛ nsia na dua w’afuo mu adeɛ, na mfeɛ nsia no pempane wo bobe turo mu nnua ho na boa emu nnɔbaeɛ ano; 4na afe a ɛtɔ so nson no nyɛ ahomegyeɛ home mma asase no, ɛnyɛ home mma AWURADE: Nnua w’afuo mu adeɛ, na mpempane wo bobe turo mu nnua ho. 5Wo ntwakaeɛ a ɛfifire no, ntwa, na wo bobehoma a woampempane no so esa esa no, ntete, ɛnyɛ ahomegyeɛ afe mma asase no. 6Na asase no home mu adeɛ nyɛ mo deɛ, na monni, wo ne w’akoa ne w’afenaa ne wo paani ne wo hɔhoɔ a wɔabɛtena wo nkyɛn, 7ne w’afieboa ne mmoa a wɔwɔ w’asase no soɔ, na ɛso nnɔbaeɛ no nyinaa nyɛ wɔn aduane.
8Na kan home mfeɛ nson, mfeɛ nson ahodoɔ nson, fa, na home mfeɛ nson no mu nna nyɛ aduanan nkron. 9#Lew 23.27 Na bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no da a ɛtɔ so du no, ma wɔnhyɛne totorobɛnto ntwa mu; mpata da no mu na momma wɔnhyɛne totorobɛnto ntwam mo asase nyinaa soɔ. 10#Yes 61.2; Luk 4.19 Na monyɛ afe a ɛtɔ so aduonum no afe kronkron, na mompae ahofadie, asase no so, mma ɛsotefoɔ nyinaa; ɛnyɛ mo ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ na mo mu biara nsane nkɔ mo agyapadeɛ mu, na obiara nsane nkɔ n’abusua mu. 11Ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ na saa afe a ɛtɔ so aduonum no nyɛ mma mo: Monnnua adeɛ na monntwa ne ntwakaeɛ a ɛfifiriiɛ, na monntete mo bobe homa a wɔampempane ho no so aba. 12Na ɛyɛ ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe, ɛnyɛ kronkron mma mo. Monni mfuo mu nnɔbaeɛ a ɛba afe no mu no. 13Ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe yi mu no, mo mu biara nsane nkɔ mo agyapadeɛ mu.
14 # 1 Te 4.6 Na sɛ wotɔn biribi ma wo yɔnko anaasɛ wotɔ wo yɔnko nsam biribi a, mo mu bi nnni ne nua amim. 15Sɛdeɛ ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no akyiri mfirinhyia ano teɛ na tɔ wo yɔnko nkyɛn adeɛ, sɛdeɛ nnɔbaeɛ mfirinhyia ano teɛ na ɔntɔn mma woɔ. 16Mfeɛ no dɔɔso a, to ne boɔ so, na mfeɛ no sua a, te ne boɔ so, ɛfiri sɛ afe afe nnɔbaeɛ na ɔtɔn ma woɔ. 17Na mo mu biara nnni ne yɔnko amim, na suro wo Nyankopɔn: Na mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.
18 # Lew 26.5; 1 Ah 4.25 Na monyɛ m’ahyɛdeɛ na monni m’atemmudeɛ so nyɛ, na montena asase no so dwoodwoo. 19Na asase no bɛba n’aduane na moadi amee, na moatena so dwoodwoo. 20Na sɛ moka sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛbɛdi afe a ɛtɔ so nson no mu? Hwɛ, yɛnnua na yɛntwa yɛn nnɔbaeɛ a, 21#Deut 28.8 ɛnneɛ, mɛhyɛ me nhyira mama mo afe a ɛtɔ so nsia no mu, na aba mfeɛ mmiɛnsa aduane; 22na modua aduane afe a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no mu a, mobɛdi nnɔbaeɛ dada no akɔsi afe a ɛtɔ so nkron no mu. Mobɛdi aduane dada no akɔsi sɛ ne nnɔbaeɛ bɛba.
23 # Dwom 39.12 Na wɔnntɔn asase no korakora, ɛfiri sɛ asase no yɛ me dea na moyɛ me nkyɛn ahɔhoɔ ne atubrafoɔ. 24Na asase a modi soɔ nyinaa, momma asase no gyeɛ ho kwan. 25#Rut 4.3-4 Sɛ ɛhia wo nua na ɔtɔn n’adeɛ bi a, ɛnneɛ ne gyefoɔ a ɔyɛ obusuani a ɔbɛn no mmra mmɛgye deɛ ne nua tɔneeɛ no. 26Na sɛ obi nni gyefoɔ na ne nsa aso na wanya deɛ ɛso gyeɛ a, 27ɛnneɛ, ɔmmu mfeɛ a ɔtɔneeɛ no ano na ɔnhyɛ deɛ ɛboro soɔ no ananmu mma deɛ ɔtɔn maa no no, na ɔnsane mmra n’adeɛ ho. 28Na sɛ ne nsa anso deɛ ɛso ananmuhyɛ no so a, ɛnneɛ, adeɛ a ɔtɔneeɛ no ntena deɛ ɔtɔeɛ no nsam nkɔsi ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no, na ɛfiri ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu no, ɔnsane mmra n’adeɛ ho.
29Na sɛ obi tɔn efie a wɔtena mu wɔ kuro a ɔfasuo wɔ ho mu a, wɔmma ne gyeɛ ho kwan nkɔsi sɛ ne tɔn afe no duru soɔ; nna yi na ɔwɔ ne gyeɛ ho kwan. 30Na sɛ wannye ma afe mu wie duru a, ɛnneɛ, efie a ɛwɔ kuro a ɔfasuo wɔ ho mu no nyɛ deɛ ɔtɔeɛ no dea korakora, n’awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu; ɔdenadeɛ no ntumi mmɛgye bio ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu. 31Na adan a ɛwowɔ nkuraa a ɔfasuo nni ho aseɛ no deɛ, wɔmmu nka asase no so mfuo ho: Wɔmma ne gyeɛ ho kwan; na wɔmmɛgye no ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu. 32#Num 35 Na Lewifoɔ nkuro a ɛyɛ nkuro a wɔdi soɔ no mu afie deɛ, Lewifoɔ wɔ ne gyeɛ ho kwan daa. 33Na sɛ Lewifoɔ mu bi annye ne fie a wɔatɔn a ɛwɔ kuro a ɔdi soɔ mu a, ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu no, ɔmfa n’adeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ Lewifoɔ nkuro mu afie ne wɔn adeɛ a wɔdi soɔ Israelfoɔ mu. 34Na wɔn nkuro ho mmoa adidibea nsase deɛ, wɔnntɔn, na ɛyɛ wɔn adeɛ a wɔdi so daa.
35Na sɛ ɛhia wo nua na ɔpa aba a, sɔ no mu na ɔntena wo nkyɛn sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ ne otudanfoɔ. 36#Eks 22.25 Nnye ne hɔ mfɛntomu, na nhuri ne ka a ɔde woɔ no, na suro wo Nyankopɔn, na wo nua nnya wo nkyɛn nkwa. 37Mfa wo sika mma no nnye ɛho mfɛntomu, na nhuri w’aduane a woma no no: 38Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a meyii mo firii Misraim asase soɔ sɛ mede Kanaan asase merema mo na mayɛ mo Nyankopɔn.
39 # Eks 21.2 Na sɛ ɛhia wo nua a ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn na wɔtɔn no ma wo a, nni no nya, 40na mmom ɔntena wo nkyɛn sɛ ɔpaani ne otudanfoɔ; ɔnsom wo nkɔsi ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no so. 41Ɛno na ɔmfiri wo nkyɛn, ɔno ne ne mma nyinaa, na ɔnsane nkɔ n’abusua mu ne n’agyanom adeɛ a wɔdi soɔ no ho. 42Na wɔyɛ me nkoa a meyii wɔn firii Misraim asase so. Wɔnntɔn wɔn nkoatɔn. 43#Lew 25.53; Efe 6.9 Mfa nyadie nhyɛ no so, na suro wo Nyankopɔn. 44Na w’akoa ne w’afenaa a wobɛnya no, amanaman a wɔgugu mo ho no, wɔn mu na tɔ akoa ne afenaa. 45Na ahɔhoɔ a wɔatu abɛtena mo nkyɛn no mma no nso, montɔ wɔn mu bi ne wɔn abusuafoɔ a wɔne mo teɛ a wɔawo wɔn mo asase soɔ no bi, na wɔnyɛ mo agyapadeɛ, 46na moagya wɔn ama mo mma wɔ mo akyi ayɛ wɔn awunnyadeɛ ne adeɛ a wɔdi so daa, na wɔnsom mo nkoasom; na mo nuanom Israelfoɔ deɛ, obiara mmfa nyadie nnhyɛ ne nua so.
47Na sɛ wo nkyɛn hɔhoɔ anaa otubrafoɔ bi nsam wɔ biribi, na ɛhia wo nua a ɔne no wɔ hɔ, na wɔtɔn no ma ɔhɔhoɔ a watu abɛtena wo nkyɛn anaa ɔhɔhoɔ no abusua mu nipa bi a, 48ɛnneɛ, ne tɔn akyiri no, wɔmma ne gyeɛ ho kwan; ne nuanom mu baako nnye no, 49anaasɛ n’agya nua anaa n’agya nua ba nnye no, anaasɛ n’abusua mu bogya bi nnye no, anaasɛ ne nsam wɔ biribi a, ɔnnye ne ho. 50Na ɔne deɛ ɔtɔɔ no no mmu nkonta mfiri afe a wɔtɔn no maa no no so nkɔsi ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no so, na ne tiriadeɛ nyɛ sɛdeɛ mfeɛ no dodoɔ teɛ, ɔne no asetena nyɛ sɛ ɔpaani nna. 51Sɛ mfeɛ no da so dɔɔso a, ne tiri sika no mu gyeɛ adeɛ a ɔbɛdane ama no no nnɔɔso saa ara; 52na sɛ aka mfeɛ kakraa bi na aduru ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no so a, ɔmmu mma no: Ne mfeɛ no ano pɛ na ɔnnane ne gyeɛ adeɛ mma no: 53#Lew 25.43 Ɔne no asetena nyɛ sɛ ɔpaani deɛ afe afe: Ɔmmfa nyadie nnhyɛ no so wɔ w’anim. 54Na sɛ wɔamfa yeinom so annye no a, ɛnneɛ, ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu, ɔmfa ne ho nkɔdi, ɔno ne ne mma nyinaa. 55Na me na Israelfoɔ yɛ me nkoa. Me nkoa a meyii wɔn firii Misraim asase soɔ ne wɔn: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose Sinai bepɔ so sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ moduru asase a mede merema mo no so a, asase no nhome nni home afe mma AWURADE. Mfeɛ nsia na dua w’afuo mu adeɛ, na mfeɛ nsia no pempane wo bobe turo mu nnua ho na boa emu nnɔbaeɛ ano; na afe a ɛtɔ so nson no nyɛ ahomegyeɛ home mma asase no, ɛnyɛ home mma AWURADE: Nnua w’afuo mu adeɛ, na mpempane wo bobe turo mu nnua ho. Wo ntwakaeɛ a ɛfifire no, ntwa, na wo bobehoma a woampempane no so esa esa no, ntete, ɛnyɛ ahomegyeɛ afe mma asase no. Na asase no home mu adeɛ nyɛ mo deɛ, na monni, wo ne w’akoa ne w’afenaa ne wo paani ne wo hɔhoɔ a wɔabɛtena wo nkyɛn, ne w’afieboa ne mmoa a wɔwɔ w’asase no soɔ, na ɛso nnɔbaeɛ no nyinaa nyɛ wɔn aduane.
Na kan home mfeɛ nson, mfeɛ nson ahodoɔ nson, fa, na home mfeɛ nson no mu nna nyɛ aduanan nkron. Na bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no da a ɛtɔ so du no, ma wɔnhyɛne totorobɛnto ntwa mu; mpata da no mu na momma wɔnhyɛne totorobɛnto ntwam mo asase nyinaa soɔ. Na monyɛ afe a ɛtɔ so aduonum no afe kronkron, na mompae ahofadie, asase no so, mma ɛsotefoɔ nyinaa; ɛnyɛ mo ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ na mo mu biara nsane nkɔ mo agyapadeɛ mu, na obiara nsane nkɔ n’abusua mu. Ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ na saa afe a ɛtɔ so aduonum no nyɛ mma mo: Monnnua adeɛ na monntwa ne ntwakaeɛ a ɛfifiriiɛ, na monntete mo bobe homa a wɔampempane ho no so aba. Na ɛyɛ ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe, ɛnyɛ kronkron mma mo. Monni mfuo mu nnɔbaeɛ a ɛba afe no mu no. Ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe yi mu no, mo mu biara nsane nkɔ mo agyapadeɛ mu.
Na sɛ wotɔn biribi ma wo yɔnko anaasɛ wotɔ wo yɔnko nsam biribi a, mo mu bi nnni ne nua amim. Sɛdeɛ ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no akyiri mfirinhyia ano teɛ na tɔ wo yɔnko nkyɛn adeɛ, sɛdeɛ nnɔbaeɛ mfirinhyia ano teɛ na ɔntɔn mma woɔ. Mfeɛ no dɔɔso a, to ne boɔ so, na mfeɛ no sua a, te ne boɔ so, ɛfiri sɛ afe afe nnɔbaeɛ na ɔtɔn ma woɔ. Na mo mu biara nnni ne yɔnko amim, na suro wo Nyankopɔn: Na mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.
Na monyɛ m’ahyɛdeɛ na monni m’atemmudeɛ so nyɛ, na montena asase no so dwoodwoo. Na asase no bɛba n’aduane na moadi amee, na moatena so dwoodwoo. Na sɛ moka sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛbɛdi afe a ɛtɔ so nson no mu? Hwɛ, yɛnnua na yɛntwa yɛn nnɔbaeɛ a, ɛnneɛ, mɛhyɛ me nhyira mama mo afe a ɛtɔ so nsia no mu, na aba mfeɛ mmiɛnsa aduane; na modua aduane afe a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no mu a, mobɛdi nnɔbaeɛ dada no akɔsi afe a ɛtɔ so nkron no mu. Mobɛdi aduane dada no akɔsi sɛ ne nnɔbaeɛ bɛba.
Na wɔnntɔn asase no korakora, ɛfiri sɛ asase no yɛ me dea na moyɛ me nkyɛn ahɔhoɔ ne atubrafoɔ. Na asase a modi soɔ nyinaa, momma asase no gyeɛ ho kwan. Sɛ ɛhia wo nua na ɔtɔn n’adeɛ bi a, ɛnneɛ ne gyefoɔ a ɔyɛ obusuani a ɔbɛn no mmra mmɛgye deɛ ne nua tɔneeɛ no. Na sɛ obi nni gyefoɔ na ne nsa aso na wanya deɛ ɛso gyeɛ a, ɛnneɛ, ɔmmu mfeɛ a ɔtɔneeɛ no ano na ɔnhyɛ deɛ ɛboro soɔ no ananmu mma deɛ ɔtɔn maa no no, na ɔnsane mmra n’adeɛ ho. Na sɛ ne nsa anso deɛ ɛso ananmuhyɛ no so a, ɛnneɛ, adeɛ a ɔtɔneeɛ no ntena deɛ ɔtɔeɛ no nsam nkɔsi ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no, na ɛfiri ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu no, ɔnsane mmra n’adeɛ ho.
Na sɛ obi tɔn efie a wɔtena mu wɔ kuro a ɔfasuo wɔ ho mu a, wɔmma ne gyeɛ ho kwan nkɔsi sɛ ne tɔn afe no duru soɔ; nna yi na ɔwɔ ne gyeɛ ho kwan. Na sɛ wannye ma afe mu wie duru a, ɛnneɛ, efie a ɛwɔ kuro a ɔfasuo wɔ ho mu no nyɛ deɛ ɔtɔeɛ no dea korakora, n’awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu; ɔdenadeɛ no ntumi mmɛgye bio ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu. Na adan a ɛwowɔ nkuraa a ɔfasuo nni ho aseɛ no deɛ, wɔmmu nka asase no so mfuo ho: Wɔmma ne gyeɛ ho kwan; na wɔmmɛgye no ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu. Na Lewifoɔ nkuro a ɛyɛ nkuro a wɔdi soɔ no mu afie deɛ, Lewifoɔ wɔ ne gyeɛ ho kwan daa. Na sɛ Lewifoɔ mu bi annye ne fie a wɔatɔn a ɛwɔ kuro a ɔdi soɔ mu a, ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu no, ɔmfa n’adeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ Lewifoɔ nkuro mu afie ne wɔn adeɛ a wɔdi soɔ Israelfoɔ mu. Na wɔn nkuro ho mmoa adidibea nsase deɛ, wɔnntɔn, na ɛyɛ wɔn adeɛ a wɔdi so daa.
Na sɛ ɛhia wo nua na ɔpa aba a, sɔ no mu na ɔntena wo nkyɛn sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ ne otudanfoɔ. Nnye ne hɔ mfɛntomu, na nhuri ne ka a ɔde woɔ no, na suro wo Nyankopɔn, na wo nua nnya wo nkyɛn nkwa. Mfa wo sika mma no nnye ɛho mfɛntomu, na nhuri w’aduane a woma no no: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a meyii mo firii Misraim asase soɔ sɛ mede Kanaan asase merema mo na mayɛ mo Nyankopɔn.
Na sɛ ɛhia wo nua a ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn na wɔtɔn no ma wo a, nni no nya, na mmom ɔntena wo nkyɛn sɛ ɔpaani ne otudanfoɔ; ɔnsom wo nkɔsi ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no so. Ɛno na ɔmfiri wo nkyɛn, ɔno ne ne mma nyinaa, na ɔnsane nkɔ n’abusua mu ne n’agyanom adeɛ a wɔdi soɔ no ho. Na wɔyɛ me nkoa a meyii wɔn firii Misraim asase so. Wɔnntɔn wɔn nkoatɔn. Mfa nyadie nhyɛ no so, na suro wo Nyankopɔn. Na w’akoa ne w’afenaa a wobɛnya no, amanaman a wɔgugu mo ho no, wɔn mu na tɔ akoa ne afenaa. Na ahɔhoɔ a wɔatu abɛtena mo nkyɛn no mma no nso, montɔ wɔn mu bi ne wɔn abusuafoɔ a wɔne mo teɛ a wɔawo wɔn mo asase soɔ no bi, na wɔnyɛ mo agyapadeɛ, na moagya wɔn ama mo mma wɔ mo akyi ayɛ wɔn awunnyadeɛ ne adeɛ a wɔdi so daa, na wɔnsom mo nkoasom; na mo nuanom Israelfoɔ deɛ, obiara mmfa nyadie nnhyɛ ne nua so.
Na sɛ wo nkyɛn hɔhoɔ anaa otubrafoɔ bi nsam wɔ biribi, na ɛhia wo nua a ɔne no wɔ hɔ, na wɔtɔn no ma ɔhɔhoɔ a watu abɛtena wo nkyɛn anaa ɔhɔhoɔ no abusua mu nipa bi a, ɛnneɛ, ne tɔn akyiri no, wɔmma ne gyeɛ ho kwan; ne nuanom mu baako nnye no, anaasɛ n’agya nua anaa n’agya nua ba nnye no, anaasɛ n’abusua mu bogya bi nnye no, anaasɛ ne nsam wɔ biribi a, ɔnnye ne ho. Na ɔne deɛ ɔtɔɔ no no mmu nkonta mfiri afe a wɔtɔn no maa no no so nkɔsi ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no so, na ne tiriadeɛ nyɛ sɛdeɛ mfeɛ no dodoɔ teɛ, ɔne no asetena nyɛ sɛ ɔpaani nna. Sɛ mfeɛ no da so dɔɔso a, ne tiri sika no mu gyeɛ adeɛ a ɔbɛdane ama no no nnɔɔso saa ara; na sɛ aka mfeɛ kakraa bi na aduru ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no so a, ɔmmu mma no: Ne mfeɛ no ano pɛ na ɔnnane ne gyeɛ adeɛ mma no: Ɔne no asetena nyɛ sɛ ɔpaani deɛ afe afe: Ɔmmfa nyadie nnhyɛ no so wɔ w’anim. Na sɛ wɔamfa yeinom so annye no a, ɛnneɛ, ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu, ɔmfa ne ho nkɔdi, ɔno ne ne mma nyinaa. Na me na Israelfoɔ yɛ me nkoa. Me nkoa a meyii wɔn firii Misraim asase soɔ ne wɔn: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

app.take_word: Take God’s Word with you wherever you go by downloading the free Bible App. Listen to audio Bibles, create Prayers, study with Friends, and much more—all for free. Choose from more than 2,400 Bible versions in over 1,600 languages on your computer, phone, or tablet.
app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
